purpose: Eliminate same-frame Aperture world-anchor drift exposed by Shift+8, where Signal Plain debug staging moved the player before later Aperture systems mounted and caused Membrane Ridge / Gathering Ground authored geometry to be offset from the visible field.

playerEvidence.observed: player still felt locked and could not reach the intended rings
playerEvidence.telemetry: 33 movement.boundary_clamped events; 21 occurred after Signal Plain opened the larger observation ellipsoid; adjacent territory observation/relationship/traversal/entry all remained zero

rootCause.law: ApertureFieldsArrivalSystem must own one canonical region-space entry anchor; debug player staging is not world-authoring truth.
rootCause.mountOrdering: SignalPlainEcologySystem can reposition the player during its first update before MembraneRidgeGameplaySystem and ApertureAdjacentTerritorySystem mount later in registry order.
rootCause.effect: later systems captured the staged player position as their own entryAnchor, shifting Ridge contours and Gathering Ground away from the visible Aperture landmarks.

acceptance: Shift+8 may stage the player without moving authored Aperture world geometry
all four Aperture systems resolve the same canonical entry anchor
all three Membrane Ridge contours remain inside the HC031T1 pre-open observation ellipsoid
Gathering Ground remains outside the pre-open volume until traversal opens
remote Gathering Ground acquisition aligns with the visible body/rings
no active-cell swap, teleport progression, global movement tuning, or targeting rewrite
